workingPrinciple: An accounting irregularity becomes relevant to price manipulation where dissemination creates a false appearance of financial health/valuation, induces investors, or distorts price discovery.
implementationGuardrail: Treat as an analytical bridge, not an automatic rule that every accounting error violates PFUTP.

workingPrinciple: Look for transaction-level commercial records, GST/tax records, bank flows, inventory/delivery evidence, counterparty confirmation and consistency across ledgers and statutory filings.
implementationGuardrail: Absence of several independent forms of evidence strengthens an inference of non-genuineness.

workingPrinciple: Circular movement by itself may be insufficient where loan/advance transactions are supported, occur in ordinary business, and are reflected in audited statements.
implementationGuardrail: Trace the substance of each leg and test the explanation; temporal proximity alone is not conclusive.

workingPrinciple: If a fraud theory depends on intermediary entities, failure to examine them or obtain corroboration can leave evidentiary gaps.
implementationGuardrail: Record which entities were summoned, examined and made noticees.

workingPrinciple: Separate receipt of prior dues and later investment cannot be clubbed without credible evidence connecting the two transactions.
implementationGuardrail: Require evidence of routing, common control, pre-arrangement or return of economic benefit.

workingPrinciple: Where alleged front allottees retain sale proceeds and no flow back is proved, that fact may undermine the allegation that allotment was financed for the promoter/company.
implementationGuardrail: Always trace the eventual economic benefit, not only initial funding.

workingPrinciple: Interim findings are prima facie and may be displaced after replies, cross-examination and further evidence.
paragraphAnchors: SSSL interim para 159; SSSL final paras 132-174
implementationGuardrail: The chatbot must label procedural stage and prefer final findings when available.
